description: Future of Mass Timber Research is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Shiling Pei, Colorado School of Mines (mines.edu). A workshop was organized to gather data from researchers and industry experts on the current and future trends in Mass Timber research. This report contains the final findings and suggestions from the workshop participants. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-z3rm-5p68. Keywords: mass timber, multi-hazard, research directions. Published 2025-08-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
